title: Pure Goyo
summary: Goyo is Officer Trudge's iconic EARTH Warrior Synchro strategy centered around stealing opposing monsters destroyed by battle. Normal Summoning an EARTH Tuner alongside Level 2/3 extenders easily accesses Level 3 Goyo Defender, whose effect immediately summons a second and third copy from the Extra Deck. These three defenders then serve as Synchro or Fusion material for Goyo Guardian, Goyo King, and Miracle Synchro Fusion's devastating 3000 ATK boss Goyo Emperor.

allow.Jutte Fighter: Trudge's signature Level 2 EARTH Warrior Tuner that switches an opponent's Attack Position monster to Defense Position (making it easy to destroy by battle with Goyo monsters to steal it!) and satisfies the EARTH Tuner requirement of Goyo Guardian and Goyo Chaser.
allow.Junk Forward: Level 3 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons itself when you control no monsters; Normal Summoning a Level 3 EARTH Tuner (Psychic Wheeleder) alongside it makes Level 6 Goyo Guardian, or pairing a Level 1 EARTH Tuner with a Level 2 makes Level 3 Goyo Defender!
allow.Super Quantum Red Layer: Level 5 Warrior that Special Summons itself when you control no monsters; pairs with Level 1 EARTH Tuner Attack Gainer to immediately Synchro Summon Level 6 Goyo Guardian without using your Normal Summon!
allow.Attack Gainer: Level 1 EARTH Warrior Tuner that pairs with Level 2 monsters to Synchro Summon Level 3 Goyo Defender (which then summons 2 more Goyo Defenders from the Extra Deck!).
allow.Spell Striker: Level 3 EARTH Warrior that banishes a Spell from the GY to Special Summon itself; pairs with Level 3 EARTH Tuner Psychic Wheeleder for Goyo Guardian, or with Level 2 Jutte Fighter for Level 5 Goyo Chaser.
allow.Psychic Wheeleder: Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner that Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Level 3 monster (Junk Forward, Spell Striker, or Goyo Defender!) and pops a monster when used for a Synchro Summon.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Jutte Fighter, Attack Gainer, Junk Forward, or Spell Striker.
allow.Naturia Beast: Level 5 EARTH Beast Synchro made with Level 2 EARTH Tuner Jutte Fighter + Level 3 Junk Forward that sends the top 2 cards of your Deck to the GY to negate Spell card activations.
allow.The Phantom Knights of Break Sword: Rank 3 Xyz made with two Level 3 Goyo Defenders that detaches 1 material to destroy 1 card you control and 1 card the opponent controls.

main: Trudge's Level 2 EARTH Warrior Tuner that switches an opponent's Attack Position monster to weak Defense Position so Goyo Guardian, Chaser, or Predator can destroy and steal it.

Level 1 EARTH Warrior Tuner that lowers an opposing monster's ATK by 1000 when used as Synchro Material, and tunes with Level 5 Red Layer for Level 6 Goyo Guardian or with Level 3 Goyo Defender for a Level 4/7 climb.

Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner that Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Level 3 monster (including Level 3 Goyo Defender!), then tunes with Goyo Defender to make Level 6 Goyo Guardian while destroying an opponent's monster!
Level 3 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons itself when you control no monsters to pair with Jutte Fighter (for Level 5 Goyo Chaser) or Psychic Wheeleder (for Level 6 Goyo Guardian).
Level 3 EARTH Warrior that banishes a Spell from the GY to Special Summon itself without using your Normal Summon.
Level 5 Warrior that Special Summons itself when you control no monsters; pairs with Level 1 EARTH Tuner Attack Gainer for Goyo Guardian or with Level 3 Psychic Wheeleder for Level 8 Goyo King.
Banishes 2 EARTH Warrior Synchro Monsters from your field or GY (such as two used Goyo Defenders!) to Fusion Summon Goyo Emperor, and draws 1 card if destroyed while Set.
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Jutte Fighter, Attack Gainer, Junk Forward, or Spell Striker.
extra: Iconic Level 6 EARTH Warrior Synchro (1 EARTH Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners; 2800 ATK): Special Summons any opponent's monster it destroys by battle to your field in Defense Position.

Core Level 3 EARTH Warrior Synchro: while you control only EARTH Warrior Synchro Monsters, Special Summons a 2nd and 3rd copy of Goyo Defender directly from your Extra Deck, turning 1 Level 3 Synchro into 3 bodies!

Level 8 EARTH Warrior Synchro boss (1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters—made with Level 2 Jutte Fighter + two Level 3 Goyo Defenders!): gains 400 ATK per EARTH Warrior Synchro on the field, and steals an opponent's monster when destroying a monster by battle!

Level 10 EARTH Warrior Fusion boss (2 EARTH Warrior Synchro Monsters; summoned via Miracle Synchro Fusion with 3000 ATK): steals any monster that you or your stolen monsters destroy by battle, and tributes an EARTH Warrior Synchro to steal any Special Summoned monster your opponent summons!
Level 5 EARTH Warrior Synchro (1 EARTH Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners): gains 300 ATK per other EARTH Warrior Synchro on the field and steals monsters it destroys by battle with halved ATK.
Level 6 EARTH Warrior Synchro that steals monsters it destroys by battle with halved battle damage.
Level 5 EARTH Synchro that mills 2 cards to negate Spell card activations.
The Phantom Knights of Break Sword
Rank 3 Xyz made with two Level 3 Goyo Defenders to destroy a card on each field.
